prompt: Fix snippets/low-carbon-shipping-flag.liquid so it renders a carbon badge for a shipment. Input: the top-level object `shipment`, which always has these keys: - `weight_grams`: integer or null - `distance_km`: integer or null - `method`: string or null - `carrier`: string or null Method: strip `method` and lowercase it. Null counts as empty. The emission factor is 62 for `ground`, 22 for `rail` and 602 for `air`. Any other value, including empty, has no factor. Output nothing (an empty string) in any of these cases: - `weight_grams` is null. - `distance_km` is null. - The method has no factor. - `weight_grams` is 0 or less. - `distance_km` is 0 or less. Otherwise compute E = floor(weight_grams × distance_km × factor ÷ 1000000). Use integer arithmetic and multiply everything before dividing. Then choose the level, in this order: 1. If E <= 50 and the method is not air, the level is `low` and the label is `Low-carbon shipping`. Air shipments are never low. 2. Otherwise, if E <= 200, the level is `medium` and the label is `Moderate-carbon shipping`. 3. Otherwise, the level is `high` and the label is `High-carbon shipping`. Output exactly one element, with no surrounding whitespace: `LABEL: E g CO2 via CARRIER` CARRIER is `carrier` stripped and HTML-escaped. When `carrier` is null, empty or whitespace-only, omit the ` via CARRIER` part, including its leading space. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/low-carbon-shipping-flag.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
